name: opsgate
description: The safety gate between AI agents and your servers. 25 typed tools for services, logs, Docker, disks, ports, files and nginx, built as argv so the agent never supplies a command string; deny-by-default policy with observe / operate / full modes per host, human approval for every change via MCP elicitation, and a hash-chained audit log that also records refusals. Local or over SSH with known_hosts verification. Single static Go binary.
